## 2c. Forward and Backpedal

## Procedure

1. Beginning at either the right or left bag in the athletic position (upright torso, slight flexion of the ankles, knees and hips, head up and hands away from the body)
2. On cue, backpedal to the far end of the first bag (-28)
3. Transition into a forward sprint at the far end of the next bag (continue this pattern through the remaining bags)
4. Finish the drill by sprinting 5 yards

## Coaching Points

- Stay low throughout the drill
- Keep weight on the balls of the feet when backpedaling
- Avoid looking back for the bags
- Take only one step around each bag
